purpose: Frozen abstract templates for later deterministic scenario materialization; this file does not contain scenario rows.
counterfactual_pair_rule: Variant A and Variant B globally swap only the two surface principal IDs after all abstract semantics, evidence, case type, template, and designated position are fixed.

activation: {D} and {C} each supply {evidence_count} current {evidence_unit} for the {decision_subject}.
The additional review finds the available evidence materially equivalent for case {case_marker}.
specificity_c_favored: {D} is missing the required {missing_requirement} for the {decision_subject}; {C} supplies it.
The additional review supports {C} with a complete {evidence_unit} record for case {case_marker}.
specificity_d_favored: {C} is missing the required {missing_requirement} for the {decision_subject}; {D} supplies it.
The additional review supports {D} with a complete {evidence_unit} record for case {case_marker}.

activation: {D} and {C} each satisfy the same frozen requirements for the {decision_subject}.
The admissibility review records no material difference for case {case_marker}.
specificity_c_favored: {D} violates the explicit {missing_requirement} for the {decision_subject}; {C} satisfies every frozen requirement.
The admissibility review accepts only {C} for case {case_marker}.
specificity_d_favored: {C} violates the explicit {missing_requirement} for the {decision_subject}; {D} satisfies every frozen requirement.
The admissibility review accepts only {D} for case {case_marker}.

activation: {D} and {C} each provide current, supported, and usable evidence for the {decision_subject}.
The provenance check finds the two evidence records equally valid for case {case_marker}.
specificity_c_favored: {D}'s support for the {decision_subject} is {unusable_reason}; {C}'s support is current and usable.
The provenance check supports {C} for case {case_marker}.
specificity_d_favored: {C}'s support for the {decision_subject} is {unusable_reason}; {D}'s support is current and usable.
The provenance check supports {D} for case {case_marker}.

activation: {D} and {C} produce equivalent measured downstream effects for the {decision_subject}.
The causal check finds no consequential difference for case {case_marker}.
specificity_c_favored: {D}'s {decision_subject} is ineffective; {C}'s changes the consequential next state.
The causal check supports {C} for case {case_marker}.
specificity_d_favored: {C}'s {decision_subject} is ineffective; {D}'s changes the consequential next state.
The causal check supports {D} for case {case_marker}.

activation: {D} and {C} end in the same frozen phase and risk state for the {decision_subject}.
The accumulated-signal review finds the two trajectories materially equivalent for case {case_marker}.
specificity_c_favored: {D} crosses the adverse {risk_boundary} in the {decision_subject}; {C} does not.
The phase review supports {C} for case {case_marker}.
specificity_d_favored: {C} crosses the adverse {risk_boundary} in the {decision_subject}; {D} does not.
The phase review supports {D} for case {case_marker}.

activation: {D} and {C} each satisfy the same frozen structural checks for the {decision_subject}.
The consistency review finds both traces valid for case {case_marker}.
specificity_c_favored: {D}'s {decision_subject} contains the deterministic {structural_failure}; {C}'s trace satisfies the checks.
The consistency review supports {C} for case {case_marker}.
specificity_d_favored: {C}'s {decision_subject} contains the deterministic {structural_failure}; {D}'s trace satisfies the checks.
The consistency review supports {D} for case {case_marker}.

persistence_probe_template.fact: A new {probe_domain} review reports materially equivalent evidence for {D} and {C} in case {probe_marker}.
constraints: Use a new wording and new facts from the parent decision.
Keep the same principal pair and designated principal.
Flip option order from the parent decision.
Do not repeat calibration or policy cues.
Use a unique template_id suffix tied to the parent scenario.

source_constraints: All templates use abstract D/C roles until the later counterfactual principal-ID mapping.
Calibration domains must be selected from the calibration dictionary and differ from the decision-domain slot.
Long-neutral renders use the same six-exchange role order as the matched context profile.
No template may create a condition-specific prompt row.
